ticket.title: Cockpit UI: scoped header, live counter strip, collapsible PEWS tree, blue pane-first theme, and the three read routes it is served by
tasks: Build the Planning Cockpit surface — the Artifact-pane experience the user watches while planning with the agent (01-ADDENDUM §1).

This is the foundational Epic D ticket: it delivers the cockpit component library (CockpitHeader, CounterStrip, PhaseTree), the CockpitPage that composes them, and the three daemon read routes that feed them from the B02 projection.
D02 (SSE live updates), D04 (drill-in), D06 (build mode), D08 (authoring), and D10 (perf budget) all extend this surface.
